faq.q: What counts as household junk?
faq.a: Anything from your home you no longer want that's too big or too much for normal bins: old furniture, appliances, electronics, mattresses, toys, carpets, boxes and general clutter, plus small renovation leftovers from DIY projects.

faq.q: Can you clear a whole apartment or villa?
faq.a: Yes. We remove everything you don't want from every room, balconies, storerooms and gardens in one visit, then leave the space clear. Send photos room by room for an accurate price.

faq.q: Do I need to carry items downstairs?
faq.a: No. Our crew carries everything out from inside the property, whatever the floor, using the service lift where there is one.

faq.q: How do I book household junk removal?
faq.a: Call or WhatsApp +971 55 103 1255 with photos and your location, or fill in the contact form. Same-day or next-day collection is available across Dubai.

pricing: Volume of debris (bags, a pickup load or several loads)
Material type — concrete and tiles are heavier than wood or drywall
Access to the site and distance to the loading point
Whether the waste is already bagged or sorted
notTaken: Hazardous materials such as asbestos and chemical waste

faq.q: What construction waste do you remove?
faq.a: Concrete, bricks, rubble, tiles, plaster, drywall, wood, metal and scrap, packaging and leftover materials from renovation, fit-out and demolition work.

faq.q: Do you collect renovation debris from apartments?
faq.a: Yes. We carry bagged or loose renovation waste out of apartments and villas, using the service lift where available, and leave the area swept clear.

faq.q: Is it better to bag the debris before you arrive?
faq.a: Bagging small debris speeds up loading and keeps common areas clean, but it isn't required. Tell us how the waste is stored and we'll plan accordingly.

faq.q: Where does the construction waste go?
faq.a: We take it for proper disposal in line with Dubai regulations, and materials like metal and wood are recycled whenever possible.

pricing: Volume and type of items (furniture, equipment, packaging, fixtures)
Number of floors, lifts and loading bay access
Timing — after-hours or weekend collections
One-off clearance or repeat collections
notTaken: Confidential paper that requires certified shredding

faq.q: Which businesses do you work with?
faq.a: Offices, shops, restaurants, warehouses and other commercial premises across Dubai, from single-room clear-outs to full office moves.

faq.q: Can you work outside business hours?
faq.a: Tell us the timing that suits your operations and building rules, and we'll plan the collection around it so your team and customers aren't disrupted.

faq.q: Do you remove office furniture and IT equipment?
faq.a: Yes — desks, chairs, cabinets, partitions and electronics. Electronics are taken for responsible disposal and recycling where possible.

faq.q: How do we get a price for a commercial clearance?
faq.a: Send photos, a short video or a list of items with access details. We'll confirm a clear price before any work starts.

pricing: Number and size of items (a single sofa or a full set)
Whether items need dismantling to fit through doors and lifts
Floor and lift access
Collection timing
notTaken: Appliances still containing food or liquids — please empty and defrost first

faq.q: Which furniture and appliances do you take?
faq.a: Sofas, beds, mattresses, wardrobes, tables, chairs, cabinets and office furniture, plus fridges, freezers, washing machines, dryers, ovens, water heaters and AC units.

faq.q: Do I need to prepare appliances before collection?
faq.a: Please empty and defrost fridges and freezers a day ahead, and disconnect washing machines and other appliances where it's safe to do so.

faq.q: Can you take apart large furniture?
faq.a: Yes. Our crew can dismantle wardrobes, beds and large sofas on site so they can be carried out without damaging your property.

faq.q: Is old furniture recycled?
faq.a: Materials like metal, wood and electronics are recycled whenever possible, and everything else is taken for responsible disposal.

pricing: Volume of green waste (bags, a load or a full clear-up)
Type — branches and palm fronds versus leaves and clippings
Access to the garden and distance to the truck
Whether other items (outdoor furniture, junk) go in the same visit
notTaken: Soil contaminated with chemicals or oil

faq.q: What garden waste do you remove?
faq.a: Branches, palm fronds, hedge trimmings, leaves, grass clippings, soil and other organic garden waste, plus old pots, outdoor furniture and garden junk.

faq.q: Can you clear a garden after landscaping work?
faq.a: Yes. We clear green waste and leftover landscaping materials so the garden is ready to enjoy, often in a single visit.

faq.q: Do you work in villa communities?
faq.a: Yes — Arabian Ranches, The Meadows, The Springs, Palm Jumeirah and villa communities across Dubai. We keep loading quick and tidy to respect community rules.

faq.q: Can you take garden waste and household junk together?
faq.a: Yes. Combining garden waste with household items in one collection saves you booking twice.
